binding_gap: There is no positional hole — the squad fields a legal eleven today. The binding constraint is the eleven-man floor interacting with the debt: the balance can only be cleared by selling, selling twice requires buying once, and the buy has to be affordable out of the two disposals. That triangle is what kills every better defender on the board and what makes the Treu sale unconditional.
